'''Reflections III''' is the 31st Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 31 October 2001.<ref name="reflections-iii-release" /> It has 200 cards (100 per side): 100 foils and 100 non-foil premiums.

Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus three unique premiums (listed under Card list)<ref name="decipher-cardlists">[https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists], Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008)</ref> and random reprints from Premiere through Endor. Those reprints are not listed. A foil of a title that is not on this list is not a Decipher Reflections III pack foil (it may be a [[Promotional Foils|promotional foil]] or a counterfeit).<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Japanese-language foils ==
Complete Card List v4 marks ten Reflections III foils as Japanese-language printings. They are Japanese-language foils inside Reflections III, not a Japanese Reflections set.<ref name="checklist-foils">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], pp. 31–32. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* [[Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese Reflections III Foil)|Grand Moff Tarkin]] (R12, VR)
* [[The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese Reflections III Foil)|The Circle Is Now Complete]] (R41, VR)

== Print sheets ==
Foils and premiums are 11&times;11 (121 cards). Each foil sheet holds 2 ultra rares once each, 21 very rares 3&times; or 2&times;, 27 super rares 2&times; and 1 blank. Its tournament foil ([[Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber]] / [[Darth Maul With Lightsaber]]) prints 4&times;. Premium sheets mix 2&times; and 3&times; titles; Dark Side objectives print on the Light premium sheet.<ref name="encyc" />
